## Loading Data

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)



my_data_folder <- "~/"
dest_file <- file.path(my_data_folder, "stressEcho.csv")

url <- "https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/stressEcho.csv"

download.file(url, destfile = dest_file, mode = "wb")
stressEcho <- read_csv("~/stressEcho.csv", na = c("N/A"))
View(stressEcho)
```

```{r}
stressEcho <- stressEcho |>
  select(-...1) |>
  rename(
    'BasalHeartRate(bpm)' = 'bhr',
    'BasalBloodPressure(mmHg)' = 'basebp',
    'BasalDoubleProduct' = 'basedp',
    'PeakHeartRate(mmHg)' = 'pkhr',
    'SystolicBloodPressure(mmHg)' = 'sbp',
    'SysPeakDoubleProduct' = 'dp',
    'DobutamineDose(mg)' = 'dose',
    'MaxHeartRate(bpm)' = 'maxhr',
    'MaxPredictedHeartRate(percent)' = 'pctMphr',
    'MaxBloodPressure(mmHg)' = 'mbp',
    MaxHeartRateDoseDoubleProduct = 'dpmaxdo',
    'DobutamineDoseAtMax(mg)' = 'dobdose',
    'CardiacEjectionFraction(percent)' = 'baseEF',
    'DobutamineEjectionFraction(percent)' = 'dobEF',
    WallMotionAbnormality = 'restwma',
    PositiveStress = 'posSE',
    RecentMyocardialInfarction ='newMI',
    RecentAngioplasty = 'newPTCA',
    RecentBypassSurgery = 'newCABG',
    HypertensionHistory = 'hxofHT',
    DiabetesHistory = 'hxofDM',
    SmokingHistory = 'hxofCig',
    MyocardialInfarctionHistory = 'hxofMI',
    AngioplastyHistory = 'hxofPTCA',
    BypassSurgeryHistory = 'hxofCABG',
    RecentEvent ='any.event',
    ECGDiagnosis = 'ecg'
    ) |>
  mutate(chestpain = case_when(chestpain == 0 ~ 'yes',
                             chestpain == 1 ~ 'no'),
         WallMotionAbnormality = case_when(WallMotionAbnormality == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                           WallMotionAbnormality == 1 ~ 'no'),
         PositiveStress = case_when(PositiveStress == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                    PositiveStress == 1 ~ 'no'),
         RecentMyocardialInfarction = case_when(RecentMyocardialInfarction == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                                RecentMyocardialInfarction == 1 ~ 'no'),
         RecentAngioplasty = case_when(RecentAngioplasty == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                       RecentAngioplasty == 1 ~ 'no'),
         RecentBypassSurgery = case_when(RecentBypassSurgery == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                         RecentBypassSurgery == 1 ~ 'no'),
         death = case_when(death == 0 ~ 'yes',
                           death == 1 ~ 'no'),
         HypertensionHistory = case_when(HypertensionHistory == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                         HypertensionHistory == 1 ~ 'no'),
         DiabetesHistory = case_when(DiabetesHistory == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                     DiabetesHistory == 1 ~ 'no'),
         MyocardialInfarctionHistory = case_when(MyocardialInfarctionHistory == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                                 MyocardialInfarctionHistory == 1 ~ 'no'),
         AngioplastyHistory = case_when(AngioplastyHistory == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                        AngioplastyHistory == 1 ~ 'no'),
         BypassSurgeryHistory = case_when(BypassSurgeryHistory == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                          BypassSurgeryHistory == 1 ~ 'no'),
         RecentEvent = case_when(RecentEvent == 0 ~ 'yes',
                                 RecentEvent == 1 ~ 'no'),
         )
```

```{r}
view(stressEcho)
```
